① Face detection (Viola-Jones framework, Ch. 11): Haar rectangle features (brightness differences) + O(1) integral-image region sums + AdaBoost selecting the most discriminative weak classifiers + a cascade structure that rejects non-face windows stage by stage. Model: haarcascade_frontalface_alt2.xml; detectMultiScale scans multiple scales with scaleFactor=1.1 and de-duplicates by minNeighbors.
② Illumination adaptation: each frame is converted to grayscale and histogram-equalized to boost contrast, reducing misses under backlight or dim light.
③ Hybrid detection & tracking (DetectionBasedTracker): the main detector scans the full frame periodically on a separate thread; between full scans, faces are re-detected only in tracked neighborhoods and positions are smoothed by weighted averaging — real-time performance at 640×480 with stable, non-flickering boxes that follow faces.
④ Data pipeline (ported from ManiiuFace): camera NV21 frame → YUV2RGBA_NV21 conversion → rotation/mirror correction per sensor and display orientation (front camera shown as a natural mirrored selfie) → grayscale → histogram equalization → detection & tracking → red box drawing.
⑤ Efficient rendering: ANativeWindow writes rows directly into the SurfaceView Surface buffer (mind the stride alignment), avoiding extra Bitmap copies back over JNI; detection, drawing and display all run on the preview callback thread.
